integrity: Proof includes exact character normalization, a complete residue-class zero classification, bridge multiplicities and a fixed-palette Stirling limit. A standalone exact integer enumerator corroborated 5209 frequency values and four additional selected coefficients. No claim of independent certification.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers only simple connected unicyclic graphs and finite abelian palettes of order at least three; the asymptotic holds at fixed palette order along resonant lengths. No classification is given for several graph cycles or weighted coloring models. Equivalence with an older unindexed complete-weight-enumerator specialization remains a priority risk.
title: Palette-uniform Fourier nullspaces for proper colorings of unicyclic graphs
